provisional_ns_cleanup.note: This case sits on a CHAOS-driven chaotic-scattering bifurcation boundary and did not reproduce on gfortran 15.2.0 (serial build: --with-par=1k --disable-gpu --disable-mpi --disable-hdf5 --enable-simd=no). Observed instead: a single BINARY CE (KW 9,1 -> 13,1, a: 7.834 -> 4.028 Rsun, matching the first COMENV pass described below) with no ENFORCED CE and no BINARY COAL; checkpoint_count still 81, but the final two checkpoints have NSCOUNT=1 (NAMENS=1, NSTYPE=13, XMNS=1.2775835252086558 Msun) instead of 0, and max|ERRTOT|=8.787025e-07 (~370x the expected value). The same mismatch, bit-for-bit, was reproduced by rebuilding unmodified source_commit c1549ca2f7d92995e54cf007eaed80d37df9289a on the same machine, including with -O0, so this is not a regression introduced by the pulsar-evolution branch -- it is toolchain/environment sensitivity in the fixture itself. The `expected` block above is left unchanged as Yuzhe Song's original recorded result. See README.md Reproducibility section for details.
